SQL:
WITH rank_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        FacRank,
        AVG(CAST(FacSalary AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_salary
    FROM university_faculty
    GROUP BY FacRank
),
faculty_with_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        f.FacRank,
        f.FacFirstName,
        f.FacLastName,
        f.FacSalary,
        r.avg_salary,
        ABS(CAST(f.FacSalary AS DOUBLE) - r.avg_salary) AS salary_diff
    FROM university_faculty f
    JOIN rank_averages r ON f.FacRank = r.FacRank
)
SELECT 
    FacRank,
    FacFirstName,
    FacLastName,
    FacSalary
FROM faculty_with_diff
WHERE salary_diff = (
    SELECT MIN(salary_diff)
    FROM faculty_with_diff f2
    WHERE f2.FacRank = faculty_with_diff.FacRank
)
ORDER BY FacRank, FacFirstName, FacLastName

WITH rank_averages AS (
    SELECT FacRank, AVG(FacSalary) as avg_salary
    FROM university_faculty
    GROUP BY FacRank
),
salary_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        f.FacRank,
        f.FacFirstName,
        f.FacLastName,
        f.FacSalary,
        ABS(f.FacSalary - ra.avg_salary) as diff
    FROM university_faculty f
    JOIN rank_averages ra ON f.FacRank = ra.FacRank
)
SELECT FacRank, FacFirstName, FacLastName, FacSalary
FROM (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY FacRank ORDER BY diff) as rn
    FROM salary_diff
)
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY FacRank, diff
